Missouri Meerschaum Corncob Pipe Lot
2 Piece Set, Vintage Tobacco Smoking Pipes
Corncob, Wood, and Plastic, Approximately 6 Inches Long
A pair of vintage corncob tobacco pipes manufactured by the Missouri Meerschaum Company of Washington, Missouri. Founded in 1869, Missouri Meerschaum is the world's oldest and largest manufacturer of corncob pipes, known for their cool-smoking properties and historical significance in American culture. These two examples feature different bowl textures and stem designs, ideal for collectors or enthusiasts of traditional smoking implements.
Lot includes two distinct corncob pipes with wooden stems and amber-toned mouthpieces
One pipe retains the original factory label on the base identifying it as a Missouri Meerschaum original
Handcrafted construction utilizing natural corncob for a unique porous smoking experience
Sizes range from approximately 5.5 to 5.75 inches in total length
Condition:
Bowls show evidence of previous use with light charring visible inside the chambers. The exterior of the corncob bowls remains structurally sound with natural variations in texture. Wood stems are secure. Plastic mouthpieces are intact without significant bite marks or cracks. Base label on one pipe is present and legible with minor edge wear. Generally well-preserved vintage condition.

This collection features twelve vintage glass telephone and telegraph insulators from prominent American manufacturers. These pieces represent a significant era in telecommunications history, showcasing various industrial glass formulas including standard aqua, clear, and heat-resistant Pyrex borosilicate glass. Matching sets and mixed lots from these manufacturers are highly collectible for their industrial aesthetic and historical utility.

Whitall Tatum Co. No. 1, Aqua Glass - characteristic greenish-blue tint, molded manufacturer marks on base
Pyrex Clear Glass Insulator - high-clarity borosilicate glass, marked "Pyrex Reg. U.S. Pat. Off."
Armstrong "W" in Triangle Mark, Aqua Glass - produced after Armstrong's 1938 acquisition of Whitall Tatum
Armstrong T.W. Smoky/Clear Glass - industrial clear glass with age-appropriate tinting and molded date codes
Additional assorted aqua and clear pressed glass insulators to complete the 12-piece set
Condition:
The lot is in good vintage condition consistent with outdoor industrial use. Several pieces show characteristic rust staining near the thread interior and top grooves from contact with metal mounting brackets. No significant structural cracks observed. description:
Natural Specimen
Quartz Geode Crystal Cluster
Mineral on Green Host Rock Matrix
Approximately 3.5" x 2.5" x 2"
Unsigned
This striking natural geode specimen features a cavity of sparkling clear quartz crystals nestled within a vibrant, teal-green host rock matrix. The exterior coloration suggests the presence of copper-bearing minerals such as chrysocolla or malachite, providing a dramatic visual contrast to the prismatic crystalline interior. This piece serves as a sophisticated organic accent, showcasing the raw geological beauty and complex textures found in natural mineral formations.
Features a well-defined interior cavity lined with translucent quartz crystal clusters
Natural green and turquoise-toned host rock with earthy iron-oxide inclusions on the reverse
Unique asymmetrical form suitable for shelf, desk, or cabinet display
Condition:
Excellent natural condition. As a raw geological specimen, it retains its original jagged edges and characteristic surface variations. The crystal points appear well-preserved within the cavity, and the surrounding matrix is stable with minor natural surface wear typical of extracted mineral specimens.

description:
Wahl Signature
Gold Filled Ring Top Fountain Pen
Early 20th Century
This vintage Wahl Signature fountain pen features a gold-filled case with a classic chased geometric pattern. Produced during the golden age of American writing instruments, this "ring top" model was designed for portability, intended to be worn on a watch chain or chatelaine. The nib is clearly marked "Wahl Signature Pen 14K," identifying the high-quality gold content characteristic of these premium writing tools. The barrel is personalized with the engraved name "E. BURKLE."
Wahl Signature 14K gold nib (tested and marked)
Vintage gold filled case with decorative chased design
Ring top attachment for chain or lanyard use
Lever-filler mechanism for ink loading
Approximately 3.75 inches in length
Condition:
Vintage condition with visible signs of age and use. The gold-filled surface shows a natural aged patina and minor surface scratches; no significant dents or plating loss observed on the exterior. The personalized engraving "E. BURKLE" is deep and legible. The internal section shows significant ink residue and oxidation at the threads and section joint. The nib shows surface wear and staining but remains structurally intact. The filling mechanism has not been restored; functionality of the internal ink sac is unknown and should be assumed to require service for writing use.
Warehouse Location: Canton
Due to our lighting, white glare lines may appear on items - This is NOT damage
If you have any questions regarding the quality or authenticity of this item or general questions regarding and item, please click Contact Seller on the item page and send us a message. We are available to answer your questions Monday through Friday, 8 am - 3:00 pm, EST.

description:
Cross
Writing Instrument Set - 14KT Gold Filled
Vintage, Includes Case and Refills
This vintage writing set from A.T. Cross Company represents the timeless elegance and precision engineering that has defined the brand since the mid-19th century. Featuring the slim silhouette characteristic of classic Cross designs, these instruments are finished in 14KT gold filled metal, offering a luxurious aesthetic combined with the durability required for daily use. The set includes a matte-finish mechanical pencil and a textured engine-turned ballpoint pen, showcasing the variety of decorative techniques employed by Cross during the mid-to-late 20th century.
14KT gold filled construction as indicated by the original interior warranty documentation
One mechanical pencil with a matte gold-tone finish and decorative center band
One ballpoint pen featuring a classic textured engine-turned pattern
Includes original brown branded hard case, fabric sleeve, and two medium ink refills (one in original gold tube)
Dimensions: Case measures approximately 7" x 3" x 2"
Condition:
Overall good vintage condition. The writing instruments show light surface wear and minor patina consistent with age and occasional use. The internal storage pouch and warranty paper are present. The hard case is structurally sound with a functional hinge, showing minor exterior scuffing. The items are untested for mechanical function or ink flow.
***Condition Disclaimer***
This is a USED item donated to Goodwill Easter Seals of the Miami Valley.
Please see images for further detail and ask any questions you may have before making a bid.

This is a polished Orthoceras fossil specimen featuring a well-preserved orthoconic shell embedded in a natural matrix. The fossil shows the characteristic segmented, linear structure with alternating dark and light bands.

- Shell: Partially polished on one side to reveal details
- Matrix: Medium brown stone with mineral inclusions and rough texture
- Shell Structure: Segmented, linear with alternating dark and light bands
- Condition: No major visible damage
- Finish: Back and edges remain unpolished

Additional Information:
The specimen combines polished and natural surfaces, highlighting the shell within its matrix.

Local pickup
is available on
select items only
, and will be noted on the item as "Local Pickup". Pickup items are available at the Goodwill of Colorado Springs Main Campus, located at 1460 Garden of the Gods, Colorado Springs, CO, 80907.

Delivery Not Received:
Please contact within 7 days of the expected delivery date if a package has not been delivered by the time provided by the shipping carrier. We will file a claim with the shipping carrier (typically FedEx) after that. Please do not file a claim before contacting us, FedEx requires the shipper to file them. If the item is returned to us because a signature could not be obtained, or if an item is returned to us as undeliverable/unclaimed it is the buyers responsibility to contact us within 7 days and pay the additional postage to mail it again otherwise items returned to us will be considered a donation and relisted at our discretion.
We are not responsible for packages that were delivered and stolen from property. Goodwill will not be liable and all refund requests will be denied.
Damaged Merchandise:
If merchandise has been damaged during shipping, please contact us within 7 days. Photos of packaging and item damages will be required for refund approval.

Description:
Discover an exciting variety of natural gemstones in this mixed lot, perfect for collectors, jewelry makers, or home decor enthusiasts. This bundle includes over 30 tumbled, polished, and raw stones featuring an array of types such as quartz, amethyst, tiger's eye, obsidian, aventurine, pyrite, and more, providing both vibrant color and varied textures. Two velvet pouches are included for safe storage of select stones, and a unique geode-shaped crystal candle holder adds a striking decorative centerpiece to your space. Each stone varies in size and form. Some are tumbled and ready for crafting or display, while others remain raw for those who appreciate a more natural aesthetic. Use this versatile collection for crystal healing, wire wrapping, meditation, or simply to add a touch of natural beauty to any setting. All pieces are natural and have not been artificially treated. Shop with confidence. These genuine gem specimens offer exceptional value and authentic appeal.

Late 1980s/Early 1990s Era

Known for their "Everyday Use" reliability, these tapes were designed for recording television series, movies, and home videos with a clear signal-to-noise ratio and a lifetime warranty. Finding a bulk quantity of these classic American-made tapes in factory-sealed condition is increasingly rare for media collectors and analog enthusiasts.

description:
Cross
Classic Century Pen and Pencil Set - Lustrous Chrome
Vintage 1980s, Ribbed Pinstripe Design
This Cross Classic Century set features the slim, elegant silhouette that has defined the brand's professional writing instruments for decades. Crafted in polished chrome with a distinctive vertical pinstripe texture, this set represents the mid-century modern aesthetic that transitioned into a timeless corporate standard. Both pieces feature the signature conical top and twist-action mechanism that are hallmarks of American precision manufacturing.
Polished chrome finish with vertical ribbed pinstripe engraving
Includes original ballpoint pen and matching mechanical pencil
Authentic "Cross Made in USA" stamps on crowns and brand logo on clips

Condition:
Excellent vintage condition with minimal signs of surface wear to the chrome finish. The original presentation box is included and is in good structural condition with minor storage wear. The set includes the original guarantee and instruction booklet.
